page_title: MON 1-5 INT | Monza v Inter 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' 1 - 5 Marcus Thuram (Inter) was like a fox in the box, burying the ball into the bottom right corner of the goal. Excellent finish!
84' 1 - 4 Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Alessandro Sorrentino.
84' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
83' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Antonio Rapuano saw the whole situation. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Inter!!
81' Substitution. Benjamin Pavard walks off the pitch and Yann Bisseck (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
80' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) replacing Matteo Pessina.
79' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
75' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
73' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alessandro Bastoni as he is replaced by Francesco Acerbi (Inter).
72' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
71' Here comes a substitution. Danilo D'Ambrosio is given a rest as he is replaced by Pablo Mari (Monza).
71' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) picks up a yellow card.
69' 1 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Matteo Pessina (Monza) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Yann Sommer no chance!
69' Matteo Pessina (Monza) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

68' Matteo Darmian (Inter) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Monza are given a penalty!
68' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.

66' What a save from Alessandro Sorrentino! Benjamin Pavard (Inter) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
64' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
62' Today's match ends for Nicolo Barella who will be replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
62' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Kristjan Asllani (Inter) replaces Hakan Calhanoglu.
60' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Marcus Thuram tees up Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Alessandro Sorrentino.
59' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' The game is interrupted. Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is coming onto the pitch as Pedro Pereira cannot continue after picking up an injury.
57' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Dany Mota (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
55' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Luca Caldirola (Monza).
53' Monza fail to score from a corner as Yann Sommer (Inter) leaps to collect the ball.
51' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
51' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is able to continue to play.
48' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Raffaele Palladino gives a chance to Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) and Warren Bondo is off.
46' Patrick Ciurria comes off the pitch to be replaced by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Antonio Rapuano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
43' An attempted cross from Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is cleared.
40' Shots on target – 0:2.
38' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
34' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
32' Celebrations are cut short for Monza as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
31' The Monza players halt their celebrations as referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
30' GOAL 1:2! The resulting free kick is headed powerfully goalwards by Luca Caldirola and Matteo Pessina (Monza) glances a header from close range into the back of the net.
26' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
23' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
21' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
19' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
16' Pedro Pereira (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
14' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Federico Dimarco laid the ball off to Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Alessandro Sorrentino gets a hand on the penalty from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
12' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
12' Referee Antonio Rapuano awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

11' Play continues despite the shouts by some Inter players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
10' That looked a certain handball by Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
7' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar.
6' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) unleashed a promising strike from a long-distance free kick, but his attempt flies way wide of the right post and it's going to be a goal kick.
5' Antonio Rapuano shows a yellow card to Andrea Colpani (Monza) for his blatant foul.
3' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Inter will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Antonio Rapuano.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
